title: A disjoint union of finite morphisms is finite
statement: Let $f_1:X_1\to Y$ and $f_2:X_2\to Y$ be finite morphisms of schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Then the induced morphism $(f_1,f_2):X_1\amalg X_2\to Y$ from the disjoint union (coproduct) of schemes is finite.
